robots.name: 胶囊 · 只减速 · 进镜→退镜

config.normal_load_model: N_eff = M * norm(g), not solved contact load
config.field_model: ideal co-moving local affine field, no actuator limits
config.reference_model: clamped position CubicSpline + RotationSpline; derivatives rebuilt
config.friction_model: smooth equivalent sliding drag, no static friction or contact
config.geometry: cylinder plus two hemispheres, total length unchanged
config.comparison_rule: same mass/moment/path/timing/gain values; inertia-aware torque gain normalization unchanged

registry.field_scope_model_notice: Widened scopes extrapolate the existing instantaneous local affine field; not a solved actuator field.

geometry.surface_notice: Colon001 inner-wall mesh, decimated shared evaluation surface; no clinical texture
geometry.coordinate_transform: none; raw STL agrees with source trajectory coordinate bounds

cameras.method_notice: Quaternion camera tracking lag is separated from residual target error caused by the forward-view cone. Slowdown follows predicted feasible tracking lag and relative angular demand. Holds are simulated from current joint state and added only if the feasible goal settles within 1.2 s; total holds are capped at 3 percent of original duration, with 8 s cooldown and 24 deg entry threshold. Slowdown is capped at 1.25 time dilation and ignores tracking lag below 15 deg. This is offline state simulation, not live image feedback. Four ablation modes share geometry and evaluation thresholds.

evaluation.notice: Shared decimated entire lumen surface; raster cell visibility; centroid distance/incidence approximation; simulated geometry quality only; no clinical texture validation

coordinationSummary.scope: Insertion coordination only; no withdrawal or observation dwell planning.
coordinationSummary.notice: Offline replay-verified scheduling, not online gimbal release. Failed or unnecessary predicted waits are removed and robot-camera dynamics recomputed until all retained waits pass exact-boundary state checks. P95 uses nearly uniform replay samples plus exact hold boundaries.

summary.method_notice: Offline geometric simulation. Fold-hidden area is approximated using 37 sampled camera directions at each 0.4-second withdrawal pose. No stationary waits; not clinical safety or image-quality validation.

roundTrip.note: The reverse replay is independently solved. Endpoint residual is exposed; no artificial pose correction is applied.
